verdict.rationale: Viam documents real-time remote inspection of deployed machines. You can stream camera feeds, read sensor data and visualize machine state from the browser, with built-in NAT traversal so no VPN or SSH is needed. GetMachineStatus and the machine API report resource health and status remotely, and the CLI can call any machine API method from a shell. missing for 10: any evidence of remote log viewing or streaming, an explicit equivalent of live topic/message inspection, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the debugging workflow.
